description.en: Multiplies a coordinate value by the technique-map scale factor, matching the scale applied by ScEventWazaMapScale — used to convert normal-map coordinates into technique-map-scaled coordinates.
Optional scale factor to apply (defaults to 0.45, matching ScEventWazaMapScale's default).

example.code:
// Scale a camera position coordinate for use on the technique map
local scaledX = ToScaleWazaMap(122.3);
